requirements.raw_requirement_text: For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or changeover.
Space must be provided for maintenance of the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor; it must not be necessary to move many pipes just to remove a small component.

The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve must be checked against the main engine requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.
